rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: I want to ask you, about your sleep.
rows.said: 我想问你，关于你的睡眠。

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Take 500 milligrams three times a day for seven days.我
rows.said: 服用500毫克，每天三次，连服七天。

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Tell me about the pain. When it started, what makes it worse, whether it spreads anywhere else, and how it affects your sleep at night.我
rows.said: 告诉我关于疼痛的情况。什么时候开始的，什么会让它加重，是否会扩散到其他地方，以及它如何影响你的睡眠。

rows.speaker: patient
rows.said: I'm afraid that if I take this medicine, I'll get drowsy.

agg.spurious_text: [patient]I want to ask[patient] you.[patient] about your[patient] sleep.
